text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you, Tsuyoshi. May I ask 
what's inside?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! It's a tea I always drink— it's 
great for stamina and vitality!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
President, you always work so late, don't 
you? I really want to help, but I'd 
probably just get in your way...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can totally vouch for this tea's 
effects! I've been in amazing shape ever 
since I started drinking it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So I'll definitely, definitely be of help 
to the Student Council President—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek, n-no, you've got it wrong! I just 
choked a little, that's all! This tea 
really is super effective, I swear!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't worry. I'm not doubting you at 
all. It is a wonderful gift, and I am 
deeply grateful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
By the way—I was wondering, do you have 
some time after this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I just happened to receive a cake as a 
gift. Eating it all by myself felt a bit 
lonely anyway.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides— I'd also like you to teach me how 
to brew such delicious tea.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
M-Me, the student council president...? 
Understood! I will do everything in my 
power to live up to your expectations!
